sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total_cents) FROM shop_customers c JOIN shop_orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.tenant_id = c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id = 1 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY c.id, c.name
